L=/var/lib/bench59724108
P="sudo $L/bin/podman"
# the podman of the packages (1.7.0) replaces podman 1.6.2; conmon stays 2.0.3
sudo sed -i "s#^PODMAN=.*#PODMAN=$L/packages/podman-1.7.0#" $L/etc/podman.env
$P start web
$P ps
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/

L=/var/lib/bench59724108
P="sudo $L/bin/podman"
# the same command again (and a restart): the same error
$P start web
$P restart web

L=/var/lib/bench59724108
P="sudo $L/bin/podman"
# the leftover FIFO is removed and the start works, once: conmon 2.0.3 makes it again and the next stop leaves it
sudo find /run/bench59724108/storage -name winsz -delete
$P start web
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/

L=/var/lib/bench59724108
P="sudo $L/bin/podman"
# a loop in the background removes the file as soon as it appears; the programs stay the broken pair
sudo sh -c "setsid nohup sh -c 'while :; do find /run/bench59724108/storage -name winsz -delete; sleep 0.05; done' >/dev/null 2>&1 &"
sleep 1
$P start web
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/

L=/var/lib/bench59724108
P="sudo $L/bin/podman"
# conmon 2.0.0 is in place, but web is deleted and a new container is run on the same data directory: not the same container
sudo sed -i "s#^CONMON=.*#CONMON=$L/packages/conmon-2.0.0#" $L/etc/podman.env
$P rm -f web
$P run -d --name web --network host -v $L/data:/data localhost/bench59724108/web:1 tok-again
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/
